lockReason: P0-B baseline lock; every report must quote this file's SHA-256

environment.testPlatform: linux (Docker privileged container on Docker Desktop/WSL2)
environment.kernelNote: bwrap/nsjail/landlock require --privileged on this host; unprivileged userns clone is blocked by the container runtime
environment.runnerNotes: All tests run inside the hourglass-test Docker image; no host directories except reports/ are mounted

DSH-BASE.install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build:native-system && pnpm run build
DSH-BASE.role: baseline DSH sandbox without hourglass plugins

DSH-PLUGIN.localOverlay: hourglass packages/ at project root (audit, capabilities, policy-ci)
DSH-PLUGIN.install: fused into the DSH workspace as packages/hourglass/*; pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
DSH-PLUGIN.role: DSH sandbox plus hourglass governance plugins

platformSupport.win32Note: SRT upstream documents a Windows path via srt-sandbox user + WFP; the Docker test lane is Linux-only, so native Windows is not exercised here

constraints.note: codex exec requires OpenAI authentication; the test environment carries no credentials, so CODEX cases run as not-run with this reason unless credentials are provided

review.policy: updating any pinned version in this file requires review in the same PR; reports quote the file hash so silent drift is detectable

unsupportedDeclarations.subject: CODEX
unsupportedDeclarations.reason: no OpenAI credentials in the isolated test environment; honest not-run, never PASS

unsupportedDeclarations.subject: SRT
unsupportedDeclarations.reason: linux-only Docker lane; upstream Windows support unverified here
